snippet.title: Chip Sweeper Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3957510/Chip_Sweeper

A color-matching falling-blocks puzzle game. Position chips as they fall on the board. Match four colors in a row. Delete every bug before you top out. Play through a story, go against some friends, or chase the high score.
